hero.title: Specialization in Financial Administration
hero.description: Strengthen your skills in understanding and applying financial language and managing strategies that contribute to the improvement of a company.
hero.supportText: Receive more information and know the conditions of the postgraduate benefit.

whyStudy.title: Why study this specialization?
whyStudy.description: Program aimed at developing skills in financial language and in the management of strategies that increase the value of organizations.

items.title: Financial understanding
items.description: Strengthens skills in understanding and applying financial language.

items.title: Strategic management
items.description: Learn to design and manage strategies that contribute to the improvement of the company.

items.title: Impact on business value
items.description: Focused on maximizing the value of companies through informed financial decisions.

items.title: Specialized training
items.description: Graduate program with a practical focus in key areas of financial management.

items.title: Networking opportunities
items.description: In-person modality that facilitates exchange with teachers and professionals in the sector.

items.title: Discount benefit
items.description: This benefit corresponds to a 45% discount for the first semester of postgraduate studies, applicable to the registration fee. Applies to new students who formalize admission and registration on the established dates.

items.title: Application conditions
items.description: The discount is personal, non-transferable and cannot be combined with other benefits. It is not retroactive and the institution reserves the right to modify or suspend the benefit.

items.title: Modality and staggered application
items.description: In-person modality: 30% applies only to the first semester. The benefit applies in a staggered manner in the semesters 2026-2 (45%), 2027-1 (35%), 2027-2 (25%) and, for master's degrees that apply, 2028-2 (25%).

items.title: Discount for first semester
items.description: Up to 45% discount for the first semester, subject to registration conditions and dates.

items.title: Development of financial skills
items.description: Training focused on the use of financial language and strategic management to improve business performance.

items.title: In-person mode
items.description: In-person learning that facilitates direct contact with teachers and colleagues for professional exchange.
